description: A beginner-friendly full body workout routine targeting all major muscle groups.

exercises.name: Chest Press Machine
exercises.notes: Press handles forward to engage chest. Keep your back flat against the pad.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Pull bar down to chest to engage lats. Control the movement on the way up.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.notes: Press platform away with legs. Keep feet shoulder-width apart.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press Machine
exercises.notes: Press handles overhead to target shoulders. Avoid arching your back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
exercises.notes: Curl dumbbells up to shoulder level. Keep elbows stationary.

description: Intermediate workout focusing on chest and triceps development.

exercises.name: Flat Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Press dumbbells upward while lying flat on a bench. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.notes: Pull cables together in front of body. Squeeze chest at the peak contraction.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Press dumbbells upward on an incline bench. Focus on upper chest engagement.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Overhead Extension
exercises.notes: Extend arms overhead using rope attachment. Keep elbows pointed forward.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Tricep Extension
exercises.notes: Extend dumbbell overhead to work triceps. Keep core tight.

description: Comprehensive back and biceps workout for muscle growth and strength.

exercises.name: Seated Row Machine
exercises.notes: Pull handles toward you keeping back straight. Squeeze shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Row dumbbell upward while keeping back flat. Perform both sides.

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Pull with underhand grip for bicep focus. Control the eccentric phase.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrugs
exercises.notes: Lift shoulders upward to work traps. Hold at the top for 1 second.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.notes: Curl dumbbells while seated on incline bench. Targets the long head of biceps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Curl dumbbells with neutral grip. Works biceps and forearms.

description: High-intensity leg workout targeting quads, hamstrings, and glutes.

exercises.name: Hack Squat Machine
exercises.notes: Perform squats at angle to target quads. Go deep for full range of motion.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Lunge with rear foot elevated. Perform both legs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Lower dumbbells keeping legs slightly bent. Feel the stretch in hamstrings.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl Machine
exercises.notes: Curl legs upward while lying face down. Squeeze hamstrings at the top.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.notes: Alternate lunges while walking. Keep torso upright.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise Machine
exercises.notes: Raise heels upward to strengthen calves. Full range of motion.

description: Complete shoulder workout targeting all three deltoid heads.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Press dumbbells overhead while seated. Keep core engaged.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Lift dumbbells outward to sides. Stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
exercises.notes: Lift dumbbells forward to shoulder height. Control the descent.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
exercises.notes: Bend forward and lift dumbbells outward. Focus on rear delts.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.notes: Rotate wrists while pressing upward. Works front and lateral delts.

description: Advanced core workout for building strength and definition.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Crunch
exercises.notes: Pull rope down while crunching. Focus on abs contraction.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Russian Twist
exercises.notes: Twist torso side to side holding dumbbell. Count both sides as one rep.

exercises.name: Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Hold dumbbell on chest during sit-up. Control the movement.

exercises.name: Dumbbell V-Sit Twist
exercises.notes: Hold dumbbell and twist torso in V-sit. Engage entire core.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Side Bend
exercises.notes: Bend sideways holding dumbbell. Targets obliques.

description: Beginner-friendly upper body workout for building foundational strength.

exercises.name: Pec Deck (Butterfly Machine)
exercises.notes: Bring arms together in front of you to target chest. Squeeze at peak.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up Machine
exercises.notes: Perform assisted pull-ups to build strength. Focus on pulling with back.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise Machine
exercises.notes: Raise arms outward to shoulder height. Control the movement.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown (Cable)
exercises.notes: Push bar downward to engage triceps. Keep elbows locked at sides.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Curl dumbbells with neutral grip. Works biceps and forearms.

description: Essential leg exercises for beginners to build strength and muscle.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.notes: Extend legs to work quads. Squeeze at the top position.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Curl legs downward to engage hamstrings. Control the movement.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Hold dumbbell to chest and squat down. Keep chest up and core tight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
exercises.notes: Step up onto platform holding dumbbells. Alternate legs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Deadlift
exercises.notes: Lift dumbbells using hip hinge. Keep back straight throughout.

description: High-intensity push workout for advanced lifters targeting chest, shoulders, and triceps.

exercises.name: Decline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Press dumbbells on a decline bench. Targets lower chest.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
exercises.notes: Press dumbbells together to activate inner chest. Maintain constant tension.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Press dumbbells overhead standing for stability. Engage core throughout.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise Dropset
exercises.notes: Perform lateral raises reducing weight each set. Push to failure.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
exercises.notes: Extend dumbbells from forehead position. Control the eccentric phase.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Kickback
exercises.notes: Extend elbow back to target triceps. Keep upper arm stationary.

description: Dynamic full body workout combining multiple muscle groups for functional strength.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squat to Press
exercises.notes: Squat down then press dumbbells overhead. Full body movement.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Clean to Press
exercises.notes: Lift dumbbells to shoulders then press up. Explosive movement.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lunge
exercises.notes: Step forward and lower knee. Alternate legs for each rep.

exercises.name: Renegade Rows
exercises.notes: Row dumbbells from push-up position. Engages lats and core.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Deadlift to Row
exercises.notes: Perform deadlift followed by row. Combines back and posterior chain.
